user.title: Connect to LinkTap
user.description: Enter the IPv4 address or hostname of your LinkTap gateway, for example 192.168.1.123 or LinkTapGw_XXXX.local. The gateway's Local HTTP API must be enabled.

error.invalid_gateway_ip: Enter the LinkTap gateway's IPv4 address or hostname only, for example 192.168.1.123 or LinkTapGw_XXXX.local. Do not include http://, a port, or /api.shtml.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the LinkTap gateway. Check the address and that the gateway's Local HTTP API is enabled.

abort.already_configured: This LinkTap gateway is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the discovered LinkTap gateway. Check that its Local HTTP API is enabled.
abort.not_linktap_device: The discovered device is not a LinkTap gateway.
abort.not_ipv4_address: The discovered LinkTap gateway did not report an IPv4 address.

init.title: Select LinkTap watering device
init.description: Choose the LinkTap watering device whose optional instant-watering safety limits you want to configure.

limits.title: Instant watering safety limits — {tap_name}
limits.description: These optional Home Assistant safety limits apply to this LinkTap device only. Each installed LinkTap watering device is configured separately. They limit instant-watering requests made by Home Assistant and do not change LinkTap firmware limits. Leave either field blank to keep the integration's existing maximum for that control.

data_description.max_watering_duration: Optional. Maximum duration Home Assistant may request for an instant watering session on this device.
data_description.max_watering_volume: Optional. Maximum non-zero volume Home Assistant may request for an instant watering session on this device. A Watering Volume value of 0 still disables that session's volume cutoff.

abort.integration_not_loaded: The LinkTap integration must be loaded before safety limits can be configured.
abort.tap_not_found: The selected LinkTap watering device could not be found.
